parts.zh: M: 我想去美国，但如果在那里接受这份工作
W: 是吗？我以为那里的薪水很高
M: 哦，是的。这份工作会很有挑战性
M: 嗯，葡萄牙有一个职位
M: 它能提供更大的保障
M: 好得多，我能拿到海外津贴
W: 想必葡萄牙那份工作会给你报销搬迁费用吧？
M: 是的，不过事情就更复杂了

items.stem: What does the man say about the job in the States?

choices.text: It is well paid.
choices.zh: 薪酬很高。

choices.text: It is stimulating.
choices.zh: 很有挑战性。

choices.text: It is demanding.
choices.zh: 要求很高。

choices.text: It is fairly secure.
choices.zh: 相当稳定。

items.stem: What benefit would the man get if he took the post in Sao Paulo?

choices.text: A quick promotion.
choices.zh: 快速晋升。

choices.text: Free accommodation.
choices.zh: 免费住宿。

choices.text: Moving expenses.
choices.zh: 搬迁费用。

choices.text: A lighter workload.
choices.zh: 更轻松的工作量。

items.stem: What does the man say is the disadvantage of working in Brazil?

choices.text: He has difficulty communicating with local people.
choices.zh: 他与当地人交流有困难。

choices.text: He has to spend a lot more traveling back and forth.
choices.zh: 他不得不花费更多时间往返奔波。

choices.text: He has trouble adapting to the local weather.
choices.zh: 他难以适应当地的天气。

choices.text: He has to sign a long-term contract.
choices.zh: 他必须签订长期合同。

items.stem: What do we learn from the end of the conversation?

choices.text: The woman will help the man make a choice.
choices.zh: 女士会帮助男士做出选择。

choices.text: The man is going to attend a job interview.
choices.zh: 男士将要参加一场工作面试。

choices.text: The man is in the process of job hunting.
choices.zh: 男士正在找工作。

choices.text: The woman sympathizes with the man.
choices.zh: 女士同情男士。

items.stem: What is the man's purpose in making the phone call?

choices.text: To inquire about the interest rates at the woman's bank.
choices.zh: 询问这位女士所在银行的利率。

choices.text: To inquire about the current financial market situation.
choices.zh: 询问当前的金融市场状况。

choices.text: To see if he can find a job in the woman's company.
choices.zh: 看看他能否在这位女士的公司找到工作。

choices.text: To see if he can get a loan from the woman's bank.
choices.zh: 看看他能否从这位女士所在的银行获得贷款。

items.stem: What can we know about rate and yield?

choices.text: There is no difference between rate and yield.
choices.zh: 利率和收益率之间没有区别。

choices.text: The man has a good understanding of rate and yield.
choices.zh: 这位男士对利率和收益率有很好的理解。

choices.text: The rate is the percentage of simple interest paid on the money.
choices.zh: 利率是资金所支付的单利百分比。

choices.text: The yield is only influenced by the amount of money.
choices.zh: 收益率只受资金数额的影响。

items.stem: What is the man most interested in?

choices.text: Long-term investment.
choices.zh: 长期投资。

choices.text: A three-month deposit.
choices.zh: 三个月的存款。

choices.text: Any high-interest deposit.
choices.zh: 任何高利率的存款。

choices.text: Any high-yield investment.
choices.zh: 任何高收益的投资。

items.stem: What did the woman do to persuade the man to deposit in her bank?

choices.text: She treated him to a meal.
choices.zh: 她请他吃饭。

choices.text: She gave him loans at low rates.
choices.zh: 她以低利率给他提供贷款。

choices.text: She offered him dining coupons.
choices.zh: 她给他提供了餐饮优惠券。

choices.text: She raised interest rates for him.
choices.zh: 她为他提高了利率。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the international coffee institute?

choices.text: It is a Portuguese company selling coffee in New York.
choices.zh: 它是一家在纽约销售咖啡的葡萄牙公司。

choices.text: Its most important task is to conduct coffee studies.
choices.zh: 它最重要的任务是开展咖啡研究。

choices.text: It represents several countries that export coffee.
choices.zh: 它代表几个出口咖啡的国家。

choices.text: Its role is to regulate international coffee prices.
choices.zh: 它的职责是调控国际咖啡价格。

items.stem: What caused the recent shortage of coffee throughout the world?

choices.text: The freezing weather in Brazil.
choices.zh: 巴西的冰冻天气。

choices.text: The impact of global warming.
choices.zh: 全球变暖的影响。

choices.text: The increased coffee consumption.
choices.zh: 咖啡消费量的增加。

choices.text: The fluctuation of coffee prices.
choices.zh: 咖啡价格的波动。

items.stem: What do we learn about Vaukin de Silva?

choices.text: He is doing a bachelor's degree.
choices.zh: 他正在攻读学士学位。

choices.text: He is young, handsome and single.
choices.zh: 他年轻、英俊且单身。

choices.text: He is a heavy coffee drinker.
choices.zh: 他是一个重度咖啡饮用者。

choices.text: He is tall, rich and intelligent.
choices.zh: 他高大、富有且聪明。

items.stem: What has occupied Vaukin's mind for the last few weeks?

choices.text: A visit to several coffee-growing plantations.
choices.zh: 对几个咖啡种植园的访问。

choices.text: Coffee prices and his advertising campaign.
choices.zh: 咖啡价格和他的广告宣传活动。

choices.text: A vacation on some beautiful tropical beach.
choices.zh: 在某个美丽的热带海滩度假。

choices.text: A quick promotion and a handsome income.
choices.zh: 快速晋升和丰厚的收入。

items.stem: Why did the couple fail to get to the cruise in time?

choices.text: They were held up in a traffic jam.
choices.zh: 他们被堵在交通拥堵中。

choices.text: They boarded a wrong coach in a hurry.
choices.zh: 他们匆忙中上错了长途汽车。

choices.text: They were late for the first morning bus.
choices.zh: 他们错过了早上第一班公共汽车。

choices.text: They were delayed by the train for hours.
choices.zh: 他们被火车耽搁了几个小时。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about their trip this year?

choices.text: It was canceled because of an unexpected strike.
choices.zh: 由于意外罢工而被取消了。

choices.text: It was spoiled by poor accommodations.
choices.zh: 因住宿条件差而被破坏了。

choices.text: It was the most exciting trip they ever had.
choices.zh: 这是他们经历过的最激动人心的旅行。

choices.text: It was postponed due to terrible weather.
choices.zh: 由于恶劣天气而被推迟了。

items.stem: What will the speaker do in the future for a vacation?

choices.text: Go overseas.
choices.zh: 去海外。

choices.text: Stay at home.
choices.zh: 待在家里。

choices.text: Take romantic cruises.
choices.zh: 乘坐浪漫游轮。

choices.text: Take escorted trips.
choices.zh: 参加陪同旅行团。

items.stem: What makes dolphins different from other sea animals?

choices.text: Their extraordinary intelligence.
choices.zh: 它们非凡的智力。

choices.text: The special bones in their fins.
choices.zh: 它们鳍中的特殊骨骼。

choices.text: The way they communicate.
choices.zh: 它们交流的方式。

choices.text: The way they get water.
choices.zh: 它们获取水分的方式。

items.stem: Why do many people enjoy collecting dolphin souvenirs?

choices.text: They love to keep them as pets just like cats and dogs.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢像养猫养狗一样把它们当作宠物饲养。

choices.text: They love them but cannot live with them.
choices.zh: 他们喜爱它们但无法与它们生活在一起。

choices.text: They can find many stores selling such souvenirs.
choices.zh: 他们能找到许多出售此类纪念品的商店。

choices.text: They believe such souvenirs can bring good luck.
choices.zh: 他们相信此类纪念品能带来好运。

items.stem: What did ancient people do with dolphins?

choices.text: They made them swim around their ships.
choices.zh: 他们让海豚在他们的船只周围游动。

choices.text: They painted their images on some items.
choices.zh: 他们将海豚的形象绘制在一些物品上。

choices.text: They hunted them in great numbers.
choices.zh: 他们大量捕猎海豚。

choices.text: They trained them to perform tricks.
choices.zh: 他们训练海豚表演技巧。

items.stem: What's happening to the dolphins?

choices.text: They are hunted in many places except Japan.
choices.zh: 除日本外,它们在许多地方被捕猎。

choices.text: They have been protected thanks to literature and film.
choices.zh: 由于文学和电影的作用,它们已经得到保护。

choices.text: They have adapted to the life in captivity.
choices.zh: 它们已经适应了圈养生活。

choices.text: They are losing their habitat and clean sea.
choices.zh: 它们正在失去栖息地和清洁的海洋。

items.stem: What's the possible advantage of virus therapy according to Prof. Seymour?

choices.text: It won't have any side-effect.
choices.zh: 它不会产生任何副作用。

choices.text: It can kill drug-resistant tumours.
choices.zh: 它可以杀死耐药肿瘤。

choices.text: It can be as effective as conventional treatments.
choices.zh: 它可以像常规治疗方法一样有效。

choices.text: It can stop cancer cells from spreading in the body.
choices.zh: 它可以阻止癌细胞在体内扩散。

items.stem: What's the big challenge facing virus therapy?

choices.text: How to find a way to deliver viruses to tumours effectively.
choices.zh: 如何找到一种有效地将病毒输送到肿瘤的方法。

choices.text: How to inject viruses directly into tumours.
choices.zh: 如何将病毒直接注射到肿瘤中。

choices.text: How to allow viruses to do what chemotherapy drugs do.
choices.zh: 如何让病毒发挥化疗药物的作用。

choices.text: How to strengthen the body's immune system.
choices.zh: 如何增强人体免疫系统。

items.stem: What does Prof. Seymour want to do with virus therapy?

choices.text: To use it to cure 75% of the patients with malignant cancers.
choices.zh: 用它来治愈75%的恶性癌症患者。

choices.text: To make it accepted by the patients with incurable cancers.
choices.zh: 使其被无法治愈的癌症患者接受。

choices.text: To apply it to those with secondary cancers.
choices.zh: 将其应用于继发性癌症患者。

choices.text: To apply it to treat all kinds of cancers.
choices.zh: 将其应用于治疗所有种类的癌症。

items.stem: What can be learnt about Amazon.com's Kindle library-lending service?

choices.text: It allows users of some Kindle devices to borrow books from local libraries.
choices.zh: 它允许某些Kindle设备的用户从当地图书馆借阅图书。

choices.text: It has benefited more than eleven thousand local libraries in the US.
choices.zh: 它使美国一万一千多家当地图书馆受益。

choices.text: It has led to a debate between publishers and libraries over e-book lending.
choices.zh: 它引发了出版商与图书馆之间关于电子书借阅的争论。

choices.text: It aims at allowing everyone to read books anytime they like.
choices.zh: 它旨在让每个人随时都能阅读图书。

items.stem: What can libraries do according to the "first sale" law?

choices.text: They can purchase any kind of media product.
choices.zh: 它们可以购买任何类型的媒体产品。

choices.text: They can lend books to readers repeatedly.
choices.zh: 它们可以反复向读者出借图书。

choices.text: They can deal with digital products as they like.
choices.zh: 它们可以随意处理数字产品。

choices.text: They can limit the time the readers keep a certain book.
choices.zh: 它们可以限制读者保留某本书的时间。

items.stem: How did HarperCollins protect the e-book industry and its own book sales?

choices.text: By allowing libraries to purchase e-books for lending in perpetuity.
choices.zh: 通过允许图书馆购买电子书以永久出借。

choices.text: By adopting the technology known as digital rights management.
choices.zh: 通过采用被称为数字版权管理的技术。

choices.text: By requiring libraries to purchase more of its e-book.
choices.zh: 通过要求图书馆购买更多它的电子书。

choices.text: By persuading the critics to support the publishers.
choices.zh: 通过说服批评者支持出版商。
